data.content_ref: inline:The proposal supplies a throttling mechanism but no causal route from reduced generative capacity to retirement of existing rivals. Scaling variator μ inversely with unretired warrants can suppress new position spawning, but the observed ~60 accepted rivals survive because they are unattacked or poorly attacked; the mechanism never maps coverage debt to warrant resolution, attack expansion, or grounded-extension reclassification. Thus it can freeze the system at a high-debt plateau rather than drive it 'back to a sustainable equilibrium.' It also gives no sandboxed_python_v1 simulation for the claimed decay–equilibrium dynamics.
